test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Quintessential
solution: The correct answer is **Typical**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The **most appropriate synonym** for the given word '**Quintessential**' is '**Typical**'. • The meaning of the word '**Quintessential**' is '**representing the most perfect or typical example of a quality or class**'. (किसी गुण या वर्ग के सबसे उत्तम या विशिष्ट उदाहरण का प्रतिनिधित्व करना।) • The meaning of the word '**Typical**' is '**having the distinctive qualities of a particular type of person or thing**'. ('किसी विशेष प्रकार के व्यक्ति या वस्तु के विशिष्ट गुण होना'।) • Hence, the appropriate answer is '**Typical**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's understand the other options. • **Fantastic**- extraordinarily good or attractive. (असाधारण रूप से अच्छा या आकर्षक।) • **Initial**- existing or occurring at the beginning. (शुरुआत में विद्यमान या घटित होना।) • **Charming**- very pleasant or attractive. (बहुत ही सुखद या आकर्षक।) 38:Ta72, The correct answer is '**We are vexed by their behaviour**'.
